name: adidas Yeezy 450 'Stone Teal'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy 450 ‘Stone Teal’ delivers a stealthy colorway of the lifestyle silhouette. A neutral grey finish is applied to the one-piece knit upper, secured with traditional lace closure and a stretchy sock-like collar. A hint of teal along the back heel adds a subtle pop of color, disrupting the shoe’s monochrome palette. The lightweight build is mounted on a PU-injected midsole, featuring distinctive lines that give the sneaker its unique, one-of-a-kind aesthetic.
